title: Property on the overlap of a quasi-compact and affine open
statement: Let X be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, P a property of opens, and assume P on affine opens and the gluing implication. Then P holds on the intersection of every quasi-compact open U with every affine open V.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 08DR proof, second paragraph

proof.text: The intersection is quasi-compact by quasi-separatedness and finite affine cover criteria, and separated as an open subscheme of the affine scheme V. Apply separated_quasiCompact_open_induction.

mathlib_searches.query: property on intersection quasi-compact affine open

lean.statement: theorem property_intersection_of_quasiCompact_affine (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (P : X.Opens → Prop) (h_affine : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsAffineOpen U → P U) (h_union : ∀ (U V : X.Opens), IsCompact (U : Set X) → IsAffineOpen V → P U → P V → P (U ⊓ V) → P (U ⊔ V)) (U V : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) : P (U ⊓ V)
